# Env (FlyEnv)

This will be **FlyEnv**, the environment of which the virtual fly will roam. It should include the following:

- [ ] 3D-rendered lightweight environment
  - [ ] bare-bone OpenGL environment
    - [ ] (unknown)
  - [ ] realistic physics in flight or walk
    - [ ] gravity
    - [ ] mesh-based boundaries
    - [ ] walking physics
      - [ ] adhesion
      - [ ] friction
      - [ ] leg mechanics
    - [ ] flight physics
      - [ ] aerodynamics
      - [ ] wing mechanics
  - [ ] proper integrations with external input
    - [ ] (unknown)
  - [ ] builtins (fly model, perception)
    - [ ] fly model
      - [ ] (unknown)
    - [ ] sensors
      - [ ] compound eyes
      - [ ] taste receptors
      - [ ] odor sensors
